title: client_objectiveai_mcp.client_request.Request
description:
Envelope: correlation `id` + tagged [`super::Payload`]. Wire shape
(the `id` field lives at the envelope level, the `type` discriminator
and the variant's payload fields are flattened alongside):

```json
{"id":"…","type":"agent_completion_notify","response_id":"…","content":{…}}
```

id.description:
Client-minted correlation id. Echoed by the matching
[`super::super::client_response::Response`].

anyOf.title: McpListChanged
anyOf.description:
The CLI's upstream `mcp::Connection` for `mcp_kind` fired
`notifications/<kind>/list_changed`. The API dispatches this
onto its per-`(response_id, McpKind)` broadcast so the
matching MCP GET-SSE listener sees a standard MCP
notification frame.
